crosswalk.title: Non-text Content
crosswalk.description: Text alternatives for non-text content (images, charts, etc.)

crosswalk.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
crosswalk.description: Alternatives for time-based media

crosswalk.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
crosswalk.description: Captions provided for prerecorded audio in synchronized media

crosswalk.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
crosswalk.description: Alternative for time-based media or audio description

crosswalk.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
crosswalk.description: Audio description for prerecorded video content

crosswalk.title: Info and Relationships
crosswalk.description: Structure and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined

crosswalk.title: Meaningful Sequence
crosswalk.description: Correct reading sequence can be programmatically determined

crosswalk.title: Sensory Characteristics
crosswalk.description: Instructions do not rely solely on sensory characteristics

crosswalk.title: Use of Color
crosswalk.description: Color is not used as the only visual means of conveying information

crosswalk.title: Contrast (Minimum)
crosswalk.description: Text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

crosswalk.title: Resize Text
crosswalk.description: Text can be resized up to 200% without loss of content or functionality

crosswalk.title: Images of Text
crosswalk.description: Text is used rather than images of text (with exceptions)

crosswalk.title: Keyboard
crosswalk.description: All functionality is operable through a keyboard interface

crosswalk.title: No Keyboard Trap
crosswalk.description: Keyboard focus is not trapped in any component

crosswalk.title: Timing Adjustable
crosswalk.description: Users can turn off, adjust, or extend time limits

crosswalk.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
crosswalk.description: Moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating content can be controlled

crosswalk.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
crosswalk.description: Pages do not contain anything that flashes more than three times per second

crosswalk.title: Bypass Blocks
crosswalk.description: Mechanism to bypass blocks of content repeated on multiple pages

crosswalk.title: Page Titled
crosswalk.description: Pages have descriptive titles

crosswalk.title: Focus Order
crosswalk.description: Focus order preserves meaning and operability

crosswalk.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
crosswalk.description: Purpose of each link can be determined from the link text

crosswalk.title: Multiple Ways
crosswalk.description: More than one way to locate a page within a set of pages

crosswalk.title: Headings and Labels
crosswalk.description: Headings and labels describe topic or purpose

crosswalk.title: Focus Visible
crosswalk.description: Keyboard focus indicator is visible

crosswalk.title: Language of Page
crosswalk.description: Default human language of each page can be programmatically determined

crosswalk.title: Language of Parts
crosswalk.description: Language of passages or phrases can be programmatically determined

crosswalk.title: On Focus
crosswalk.description: Receiving focus does not initiate a change of context

crosswalk.title: On Input
crosswalk.description: Changing setting of any UI component does not automatically cause a change of context

crosswalk.title: Consistent Navigation
crosswalk.description: Navigation mechanisms are consistent across pages

crosswalk.title: Consistent Identification
crosswalk.description: Components with the same functionality are identified consistently

crosswalk.title: Error Identification
crosswalk.description: Input errors are automatically detected and described to the user

crosswalk.title: Labels or Instructions
crosswalk.description: Labels or instructions provided when content requires user input

crosswalk.title: Error Suggestion
crosswalk.description: If an input error is detected, suggestions for correction are provided

crosswalk.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
crosswalk.description: Submissions are reversible, checked, or confirmed for legal/financial/data

crosswalk.title: Parsing
crosswalk.description: Elements have complete start/end tags, no duplicate attributes, unique IDs

crosswalk.title: Name, Role, Value
crosswalk.description: Name and role can be programmatically determined for all UI components
